panels.title: Verification age by host
panels.description: Counts successful re-verifications. Initial baseline hashes remain in the never bucket until a later hash matches.

targets.rawSql: SELECT host, count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_verified_at >= now()-interval '7 days') AS "0-7d", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_verified_at < now()-interval '7 days' AND last_verified_at >= now()-interval '30 days') AS "7-30d", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_verified_at < now()-interval '30 days' AND last_verified_at >= now()-interval '90 days') AS "30-90d", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_verified_at < now()-interval '90 days') AS "90d+", count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_verified_at IS NULL) AS "never" FROM diskaudit.v_infra126_verification_age GROUP BY host ORDER BY host

SELECT file_key,host,path,mutable_score,decision_state,operator_action,operator_verdict,last_seen_divergence_at,plane_ticket_id FROM diskaudit.corruption_suspects WHERE last_seen_divergence_at >= date_trunc('month',now()) ORDER BY mutable_score ASC,last_seen_divergence_at DESC
SELECT host||' Tier-'||tier AS metric,pct_on_time AS value FROM diskaudit.v_infra126_sla_status ORDER BY host,tier

SELECT mutable_score AS x,count(*) AS y,divergence_type AS series FROM diskaudit.hash_divergences WHERE created_at >= now()-interval '30 days' GROUP BY mutable_score,divergence_type ORDER BY mutable_score
